rankRules.lootRefresh: one deterministic set per quest departure; never reroll by area transition
rankRules.higherRankNodeAccess: same field node anchors, new loot tables chosen by accepted quest rank, not hunter inventory rank
rankRules.rarityAssurance: no guaranteed rare per use; first-clear dedicated exploration quests may award one non-monster rare material as relief
rankRules.rareRollVisibility: rare point visuals distinguish seam strength, never disclose final result
rankRules.dropBounds: never grant a material requiring a higher rank than the active quest

equipment.rule: monsters/materials-from-other-node-kinds never required; coins allowed. All ranks direct craft without circular requiring same rank gear
equipment.note: Equipment and material IDs are proposed; do not paste into generated public/data/equipment_series.json or active loaders without adapting runtime schema. Existing gathering 9 series remain unchanged.

stateContract.oneUseConsumption: successful effect tick only, cancel before effect must not consume tool charge, loot or node use
stateContract.questScope: nodes only regenerate after departure; per-node usage is part of run state, unaffected by switching areas
stateContract.inventory: normal hunt items stored in quest bag and settled once into existing persistent inventory, unlike quest-specific delivery bag
stateContract.persistence: idempotent runId settlement and explicit migration; old saves retain unknown IDs
stateContract.input: sheathed primary interaction only; never starts an attack while near active node and pressing gather
stateContract.map: undiscovered points hidden; discovered node category shown on local and full map; rare result never revealed
stateContract.risk: monster can interrupt gathering and causes no item gain or charge consumption before effect tick

qa.expect: 11エリアの候補点はすべて各エリアの歩行形状内
出口6.5m、岩外周1.9m、登攀縁5m以上から離す。ゲーム内当たり判定で再検査
採取後のエリア移動で枯渇しない。再出発では復活
同一の保存データ・依頼・seedで採取結果の順序が一致
初級で上級以上の鉱石・骨が出ない
採集5種とも納刀状態・道具・アニメーションの契約が適用される
魚影と釣りは水面と地形の実装後だけ有効
生産・強化の素材が鉱石だけ／環境骨だけで閉じ、討伐ゼロで入手可能
直接生産および強化は通貨・素材を1度だけ消費
既存の5つの非狩猟依頼、既存所持品と旧保存データを壊さない
レア度や採取回数は可視化するが、最終抽選はプレイヤーに予告しない
2Gの元データ・画像・確率値を複写していない（Kari独自値）
